title: P3 model material lock helper input, version 1
description: Lock structure only. Null metadata is unknown, never latest; this schema intentionally has no data_kind field.
$comment: Run p3_evidence.py check-lock after schema validation. The helper additionally rejects duplicate JSON object keys, duplicate entry IDs and globally duplicate file paths. It validates URL scheme=https, hostname, absence of credentials/whitespace using urllib.parse.urlsplit; the string pattern here is only a structural screen, not an exact URL parser. It validates normalized relative POSIX paths (no absolute path, dot/dot-dot traversal, redundant separators, colon, or backslash). --root additionally checks resolved-path containment (including symlink escapes), regular files, existence, size and SHA-256. These runtime filesystem checks cannot be expressed by this schema. Null revision/hash/size or empty files on required entries yield unresolved / exit 2; optional pending entries do not block. Empty entries are structurally allowed by the helper and do not prove that any model exists. JSON Schema integer may accept lexical 1.0; helper version and size require Python int, not bool. No model, provenance, license, quality, resource or release eligibility is verified.

source_url.$comment: Authoritative hostname/credentials validation is performed by helper URL parsing, not this partial structural pattern.

path.$comment: Non-whitespace path string here; normalized relative path, traversal/absolute-path rejection, global path uniqueness, symlink containment and regular-file checks are enforced by helper.
